correctness.rationale: If xRy and yRz then z=x or z=y by weak transitivity plus unique successor, so the generated stream is terminal, 1-cycle, length-two ending terminal/loop or 2-cycle. Monochrome two-cycles are bisimilar to loops. Five disjoint types T(a), F(a), L(a,b), R(a,b) (a!=b), P(a,b) (a!=b) count q+q+q^2+2q(q-1)=3q^2. Characteristic formulas of depth at most two distinguish them. Their canonical disjoint union is itself functional weakly transitive; characteristic disjunctions define every powerset subset. Monochrome loop and two-edge path to a sink are depth-one equivalent but depth-two distinct. Type exclusivity gives optimal universe size. Independently enumerated 308140 rooted coloured functional weakly-transitive cases on <=5 labelled worlds and canonical q=1,2,3 type totals 3,12,27. Finite enumeration corroborates but is not the proof for arbitrary infinite frames.
